findings.body: Raise: Test. This fixture applies Claude coordination to every timing scenario, including `claude_failed` and the clean cases that run a Claude worker at lines 60 and 76. Once same-tool work becomes native, those cases will no longer run their Claude stub or satisfy their timing assertions. The ruling considered the initial Claude round; the fallback is on the coordinator's tool and will take the native route.
